name: threads-sync
description: Cross-platform Obsidian Markdown sync preview with independent Google sign-in.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/sync-smoke.mjs && node scripts/sync-smoke.mjs --mobile
